question.text: What is the TDS rate on IDCW paid to NRI investors?

answer.text: 10% for equity schemes, 20% for debt schemes

explanation.text: The Logic: For Non-Resident Indians, TDS shall be 20% of the dividend/IDCW amount paid by the mutual fund. The Trap: 10% is the resident TDS rate, not the NRI rate. Candidates may also wrongly assume different rates for equity vs debt schemes — the 20% NRI TDS rate is uniform. Note: The 20% NRI TDS rate is the workbook position; treaty relief and other adjustments are outside the basic rule tested here.
